title: Рыба фугу и новая мечта  (Fugu Fish and a New Dream)

scenes.title: Daughter's First Smile and Chef's Return
scenes.summary: Max celebrates his baby daughter's first smile, and Chef Barinov returns to take back command of the kitchen.

scenes.title: The Story About Eleonora's Illness
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov hides the truth about his contract penalty by telling the kitchen crew that Eleonora is seriously ill.

scenes.title: Cocoa with Marshmallows and a Kiss
scenes.summary: Nikita wins Katya's heart with her favorite childhood cocoa with marshmallows, and Fedya teases them when she kisses him.

scenes.title: Fresh Fugu Fish and Oguzok's Challenge
scenes.summary: Max boasts that his pâté won the Michelin inspector's praise, provoking Chef Barinov into challenging him to cook poisonous fugu.

scenes.title: A Deadly Wager
scenes.summary: Max bluffs that he knows how to cook fugu, and he and Chef Barinov agree to each prepare and taste the poisonous fish.

scenes.title: Rumors Across the Whole Hotel
scenes.summary: Mikhail Dzhekovich scolds a maid for gossiping, then learns in shock that the whole hotel believes Eleonora is dying.

scenes.title: The Karate and Violin Prank
scenes.summary: Fedya and Senya secretly text Gulya from Lyova's phone bragging about karate and violin, and Gulya admires Lyova.

scenes.title: One Month Left and Fugu Instructions
scenes.summary: Mikhail overhears Eleonora say she has only a month left on her passport and thinks she is dying, while Timur delivers the fugu fish.

scenes.title: The Final Warning Before Filleting
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov warns Max one last time about the deadly fugu and stops him from touching the poisonous fish without gloves.

scenes.title: The Line for the Laundry Room and Half a Fish
scenes.summary: Nikita and Lyova make awkward excuses outside the laundry room, while Chef Barinov and Max each fillet half of the fugu.

scenes.title: Swapping the Fillet and Champagne in the Hall
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov secretly swaps Max's improperly cut fugu with his own safe fillet so Max will not be poisoned.

scenes.title: Poisoning Symptoms During a Proposal
scenes.summary: As Chef Barinov describes the symptoms of fugu poisoning to Max, Nagiyev suffers those exact symptoms while proposing to Eleonora.

scenes.title: The Ambulance and the Forgotten Gloves
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Chef Barinov are hospitalized with mild fugu poisoning because Victor forgot to change his gloves when saving Max.

scenes.title: The New Head Chef of Claude Monet
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov convinces Nagiyev in the hospital to hire Max as the new head chef of Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Max's News and Vika's Move to Saint Petersburg
scenes.summary: Max tells Vika he has been named head chef of Claude Monet, but Vika reveals she is moving to Saint Petersburg with their daughter.

scenes.title: An Accidental Discovery on Nikita's Phone
scenes.summary: While Gulya laughs about Fedya and Senya's phone prank, Katya accidentally sees secret messages from Eleonora on Nikita's phone.

scenes.title: Exposing the 'Cosmic Bond'
scenes.summary: Katya confronts Nikita for conspiring with her mother Eleonora and lying to her about the car theft and the cocoa.

scenes.title: Choosing Between a Dream and Family
scenes.summary: Max turns down the head chef position at Claude Monet, telling Nagiyev that his wife and daughter come before his career.

scenes.title: Lessons of a Great Story and a Wedding Date
scenes.summary: Max reflects on the lessons learned by the kitchen team while Nagiyev and Eleonora agree to hold their wedding in two months.

scenes.title: A Happy Finale and a New Chapter
scenes.summary: Eleonora announces she is marrying Nagiyev, while Vika stays in Moscow with Max as he becomes head chef of Claude Monet.
